headline: Across media, gaming, publishing and education, firms show mixed financial results but broadly increasing tech investment.
summary: Media giants report solid revenue growth and new AI partnerships, though some face margin pressure. Gaming operators are split, with strong digital revenue gains at Bally's but losses at Caesars. Publishing sees a bright spot at Pearson while Scholastic struggles. Education players invest in AI and quantum projects, yet cost cuts appear at some institutions.

industries.summary: Disney posted 7% revenue growth and strong operating income. WBD/Skydance saw flat revenue and lower margins. Versant expanded digital platforms and acquired a golf‑simulator firm.

leaders.why: Highest revenue ($25,248 m) and strong margin growth

laggards.why: Revenue down YoY and low operating margin
